Messages.Author: Pat Ricochet
Messages.Body:
Okay, until Google gets the archive online, I'll never know that this has
been asked or not:

Rumors of Gehenna [Jyhad, V:TES]
Cardtype: Political Action
Political Card-Worth 1 Vote. Called by any vampire at +1 stealth. Choose a
set of Methuselahs. Successful <referendum> means each chosen Methuselah
receives 2 master phase actions during his or her master phase (instead of
1). Any vampire can burn this card with a successful <referendum>; calling
this <referendum> is a +1 stealth <political> action.

This is a minion card, not a master card. Who controls it? Anyone?

If I call Rumors of Gehenna, and give everyone 2 master phase actions, and
then I'm ousted, what happens?
1) The card remains in play, and everyone else keep their master phase
actions?
2) The card goes when I go, and everyone loses their extra master phase
actions.

Something that seems to be missing is a "put this card in play" sentence
or somesuch. It certainly *implies* that since you can vote the card to
burn, that burning the card removes the effect of the card, but that's not
explicit. Seems obvious, though, or why would you burn the card?

But, if the card is in play to be burned, doesn't SOMEONE have to
control it?

Related, I can certainly call a Rumors and give everyone but my prey 2
master phases, but then my predator calls a Rumors to give everyone 2 master
phase actions. This is legal, and both cards remain in play, yes? And each
Rumors would have to be voted down separately?

--
Pat Ricochet
Soul Jar'rn Fool of Atlanta
